Acquisition.description: Extracted technical acquisition protocol record, with or without an associated participant paradigm.

acquisition_duration_seconds.description: How long the acquisition ran, in seconds. A run length, not the total across runs, unless the source gives only the total.

description.description: Narrative account of the acquisition, verbatim, holding whatever this schema has no field for. Fill this in rather than dropping a reported parameter, whatever the modality.

eeg.description: Fill in for an EEG recording.

fnirs.description: Fill in for an fNIRS recording.

instrument.description: Scanner, amplifier, or recording system, verbatim, including manufacturer and model.

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor; resolved to stable ID by mapper.

modality.description: Modality as stated in the paper (e.g., "functional MRI", "DTI"), verbatim; the mapper normalizes it to the storage Modality vocabulary. Do not translate it here, and do not omit a modality the vocabulary has no obvious slot for -- an unmatched label lands on `other` with the label preserved.

mri.description: Fill in for an MRI acquisition of any kind, functional, structural, or diffusion.

other.description: Fill in only for a modality none of the four above covers, such as MEG, SPECT, ultrasound, or intracranial EEG. Extra parameters for a modality that does have a class go in description or structured_details, not here.

pet.description: Fill in for a PET scan.

structured_details.description: JSON-encoded acquisition parameters that no field below accepts, when the reported parameters have structure worth keeping. A string because the schema has no free-form object range.

Acquisition.title: Acquisition

Analysis.description: Extracted analysis record, including direct links and analysis-level inference metadata.

acquisitions.description: local_ids of Acquisition records supplying data to this analysis. Extract these explicitly, including for structural, diffusion, and other analyses without an associated Experiment.

assessments.description: local_ids of Assessment records used by this analysis.

baseline.description: What the map was tested against, verbatim -- a named condition such as rest or fixation, an implicit baseline, chance, or zero; mapper normalizes. Do not invent a baseline condition: if the baseline is a modelled condition, give it a condition term on the lesser side instead.

component_decomposition.description: Fill in for ICA and related component maps.

conditions.description: The conditions entering this analysis and, for each, which side of the comparison it sits on. Every condition the analysis uses gets an entry, directional or not.

conjunction.description: Fill in for a logical combination of independently defined effects.

connectivity.description: Fill in for a connectivity analysis -- PPI, gPPI, seed-based, DCM, Granger causality, or coherence.

coordinate_space.description: Coordinate space the results are reported in, verbatim, such as "MNI space" or "Talairach"; mapper normalizes. Extract it from the Methods even when the tables state it, because table parsing does not always recover it.

decoding.description: Fill in for a classification or pattern-discriminability analysis.

experiments.description: local_ids of the Experiment records this analysis draws on. Multivalued because an analysis can span paradigms -- a cross-task conjunction, or a localizer plus a main task. Empty for an analysis with no paradigm, which is linked through acquisitions.

groups.description: The participant cohorts in this analysis and, for each, which side of the comparison it sits on and how many of its participants this analysis included.

inference_settings.description: Thresholding and correction settings for this analysis. Fill this in per analysis, since papers routinely use one threshold for whole-brain tests and another inside an ROI.

interpretations.description: What the authors say the analysis measures, in their words. A claim about the paper's own reading, never the extractor's, and never a substitute for the definition.

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor.

measure.description: The scientific quantity of the map, in the source's words.

mediation_path.description: For a mediation analysis, which path was tested, verbatim -- the direct effect, the indirect or mediated path, or the total effect; mapper normalizes. Omit otherwise.

model_representation_notes.description: Model components this schema could not represent, verbatim -- random slopes, latent variables, custom basis functions, dependencies between terms. Fill this in rather than dropping a component; it is how the gap becomes visible.

not_structurable.description: Fill in only when the effect is grounded in the source but has no stable structured decomposition at all -- not merely a method outside the named families, which is other_method.

other_method.description: Fill in for a method none of the five above covers, such as a mediation analysis. Leave all six empty for a mass-univariate analysis -- a voxelwise, vertexwise, or ROI-wise GLM, mixed-effects model, ANOVA, ANCOVA, or robust regression -- which needs no method payload.

preprocessing.description: local_id of the Preprocessing pipeline used.

roi_definition.description: How a region of interest was defined, verbatim -- an atlas or parcellation, prior literature, an a priori anatomical region, a separate functional localizer, or this study's own earlier analysis; mapper normalizes. Omit for a whole-brain or searchlight analysis.

roi_label.description: The atlas, parcellation, or region name, verbatim. Omit for a whole-brain analysis.

similarity.description: Fill in for a representational-similarity analysis, where the association is at the level of dissimilarity matrices. A similarity regressor entered into a univariate GLM is a parametric modulation instead, recorded as a Term.

spatial_scope.description: Spatial extent of the inference, verbatim -- whole brain, one or more regions of interest, or a searchlight; mapper normalizes.

spatial_unit.description: The element the analysis ran over, verbatim -- voxels, surface vertices, averaged regions, or parcels; mapper normalizes. Distinct from spatial_scope, which gives the extent.

statistic.description: The test statistic reported for this analysis and its degrees of freedom.

statistical_maps.description: Statistical images made available for this analysis, usually in a repository such as NeuroVault.

tables.description: local_ids of Table records reporting results.

terms.description: local_ids of Term records entering this analysis.

Analysis.title: Analysis

assessment_type.description: Broad type, verbatim -- a cognitive test, clinical scale, questionnaire, behavioural task, physiological measure, or a biospecimen assay such as salivary cortisol.

description.description: What the assessment measured and how, verbatim.

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor.

name.description: The instrument's name as the paper gives it, such as Digit Span, MMSE, or BDI-II.

category.description: The category label as the study writes it, not normalized to any external scheme.

count.description: How many participants fall in this category, when the source gives a count.

denominator.description: The total the count or percentage is out of, when it is not the whole group -- a distribution reported for the subset who answered, for instance.

percentage.description: The percentage in this category, when the source gives a percentage rather than a count.

reporting_framework.description: The classification system behind these categories, verbatim, such as the OMB or NIH race and ethnicity categories or a named handedness inventory. Free-text categories only compare across studies when the scheme is known.

ComponentDecompositionDetails.description: Method payload for ICA and related component maps.

component_id.description: Identifier of the component within the decomposition, as reported.

component_label.description: The source's name for the component, verbatim, such as a network label.

map_quantity.description: What the values of the reported map represent, verbatim -- a loading, a weight, a z-score, or a spatial map; mapper normalizes.

method.description: Decomposition method, verbatim, such as ICA, tensor ICA, PCA, or dictionary learning; mapper normalizes.

polarity_semantics.description: Whether the sign of the map carries meaning, verbatim; mapper normalizes. Decomposition methods can return components whose polarity is arbitrary, in which case a negative loading is not a decrease.

selection_criterion.description: How this component was selected for reporting, verbatim.

total_components.description: Number of components the decomposition produced.

ComponentDecompositionDetails.title: ComponentDecompositionDetails

condition_kind.description: What kind of thing this condition is, verbatim or as judged -- a task state, a class of stimulus, rest, a timepoint, a drug, brain stimulation, a training or therapy programme, or a comparator such as a placebo, a sham, an active comparator, usual care, or no intervention; mapper normalizes. Type the comparator as carefully as the manipulation.

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor.

name.description: Condition label as stated in the paper.

ConditionTerm.description: One experimental condition entering an analysis and the side of the comparison it sits on.

factor_levels.description: The factorial cell this condition represents. Record a factor held constant across the directional terms as well, with its constant level.

label.description: The source's wording for this condition in this analysis, verbatim, when it differs from the Condition name.

role.description: Which side of the comparison this condition sits on, verbatim as the source frames it; mapper normalizes. For an ordered contrast mark the extremes and leave the middle terms undirected, keeping the ordering in contrast_definition.

ConditionTerm.title: ConditionTerm

ConjunctionComponent.description: One component effect of a conjunction.

analysis_id.description: local_id of the sibling Analysis record for this component, when it is separately reported.

analysis_type.description: The component's own method, verbatim, when it is known and differs from the others.

definition.description: Statement of the component effect, verbatim, including its direction.

ConjunctionComponent.title: ConjunctionComponent

ConjunctionDetails.description: Method payload for a logical combination of independently defined effects.

components.description: The independently defined effects that were combined.

implementation.description: Procedure that computed the conjunction, verbatim, such as a minimum-statistic test, masking, or a logical OR; mapper normalizes.

null_hypothesis.description: Which null hypothesis was tested, verbatim -- the global null or the conjunction null; mapper normalizes.

ConjunctionDetails.title: ConjunctionDetails

ConnectivityDetails.description: Method payload for a connectivity analysis.

connectivity_method.description: Method used to estimate connectivity, verbatim -- PPI, gPPI, seed-based correlation, DCM, Granger causality, or coherence; mapper normalizes.

edges.description: Named region pairs, when the source reports specific edges.

inference_target.description: What the analysis drew inference about, verbatim -- a connectivity parameter, a model comparison, or a network; mapper normalizes.

modulatory_input.description: Modulatory input of the model, verbatim, for DCM and related methods.

parameter_change.description: Whether the experimental effect raised or lowered the connectivity parameter, verbatim; mapper normalizes.

parameter_sign.description: Sign of the connectivity parameter itself, verbatim, such as a negative PPI; mapper normalizes.

target_regions.description: Target regions, verbatim. Empty for a seed-to-whole-brain analysis.

ConnectivityDetails.title: ConnectivityDetails

ConnectivityEdge.description: One reported connection between two named regions.

directionality.description: Whether this edge is directed, verbatim; mapper normalizes. Only a directed model such as DCM or Granger causality supports a direction -- never infer one the method cannot support.

parameter_sign.description: Sign of this edge's parameter, verbatim, when reported per edge.

ConnectivityEdge.title: ConnectivityEdge

DecodingClass.description: One class discriminated by a decoding analysis.

condition.description: local_id of the Condition this class corresponds to, when it is one.

DecodingClass.title: DecodingClass

DecodingDetails.description: Method payload for a classification or pattern-discriminability analysis.

decoded_variable.description: The variable the classifier or discriminability test predicted, verbatim.

generalization.description: Train and test split for cross-decoding, verbatim, when the analysis generalized across sets.

performance_metrics.description: Every performance measure the paper reports for this analysis, one entry each, with its value. Record all of them -- a paper giving accuracy, sensitivity and specificity gets three entries, not one.

validation_scheme.description: Cross-validation or resampling scheme, verbatim, such as leave-one-run-out.

DecodingDetails.title: DecodingDetails

eeg_channel_count.description: How many recording channels were used, excluding reference and ground unless the source counts them.

eeg_placement_scheme.description: The electrode layout system, verbatim, such as the 10-20 or 10-10 system.

eeg_reference.description: The reference the raw signal was recorded against, verbatim -- linked mastoids, a common average, a named electrode.

recording_type.description: How the recording was organized, verbatim -- continuous, discontinuous, or already epoched.

sampling_frequency_hz.description: Sampling rate of the recording in hertz.

Evidence.description: Evidence associated with an extracted value.
Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceSet.description: One independently sufficient set of source-text spans supporting a value.
EvidenceSet.title: EvidenceSet

EvidenceSpan.description: An exact source-text span used as evidence for an extracted value.
EvidenceSpan.title: EvidenceSpan

EvidenceStatus.description: Indicates whether source-text evidence was identified for an extracted value.
EvidenceStatus.title: EvidenceStatus

Experiment.description: Extracted meaningful participant paradigm, such as a task, resting-state protocol, stimulation, or passive viewing.

acquisitions.description: local_ids of Acquisition records collected as part of this experiment. Use multiple entries for simultaneously collected modalities (e.g., EEG and fMRI) or for site-specific variants of the experimental acquisition. Do not attach structural or other non-paradigm scans merely because they were collected in the same session.

conditions.description: local_ids of Condition records belonging to this experiment.

design_type.description: Design form as stated in the paper (e.g., "event-related", "block design"); mapper normalizes to controlled vocabulary.

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor; resolved to a stable ID by the mapper.

task_description.description: Full narrative description of the paradigm, verbatim.

task_name.description: Task or paradigm label as stated in the paper, when applicable.

task_performance_measures.description: Behavioral outcome variables, verbatim, one per entry.

Experiment.title: Experiment

ExternalDataset.description: Evidence-backed extraction of a named external dataset and its optional URL.

name.description: Dataset name as stated in the source.

url.description: Dataset URL as stated in the source, when available.

ExternalDataset.title: ExternalDataset

ExtractedInteger.description: An ExtractedValue whose value is a whole number.

value.description: Extracted or generated value. Populate when extraction_status is extracted; omit when it is not_reported.

ExtractedInteger.title: ExtractedInteger

ExtractedNumber.description: An ExtractedValue whose value is numeric, including fractional values.

value.description: Extracted or generated value. Populate when extraction_status is extracted; omit when it is not_reported.

ExtractedNumber.title: ExtractedNumber

ExtractedString.description: An ExtractedValue whose value is text.

value.description: Extracted or generated value. Populate when extraction_status is extracted; omit when it is not_reported.

ExtractedString.title: ExtractedString

ExtractedValue.description: A schema attribute explicitly examined during extraction, including its value, source, and supporting evidence.

value.description: Extracted or generated value. Populate when extraction_status is extracted; omit when it is not_reported.

ExtractedValue.title: ExtractedValue

ExtractionMetadata.description: Pipeline provenance stamped onto the extraction record at generation time.

extractor_model.description: Model identifier used for extraction, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6.

extractor_version.description: Version string of the extraction prompt or pipeline.

paper_sections.description: Complete deterministic index of all paper sections and subsections, including character spans.

source_text_hash.description: SHA-256 of the paper text processed, for reproducibility checking.

ExtractionMetadata.title: ExtractionMetadata

ExtractionStatus.description: Outcome of explicitly examining a requested attribute during extraction.
ExtractionStatus.title: ExtractionStatus

nirs_channel_count.description: How many source-detector pairs were recorded, which is not the number of optodes.

nirs_placement_scheme.description: The optode layout, verbatim -- a standard system such as 10-20, or the listed positions.

nirs_system_type.description: The instrument's measurement principle, verbatim -- continuous-wave, frequency- domain, or time-domain.

recorded_signal_types.description: What the channels recorded, verbatim -- raw continuous-wave amplitude, optical density, or concentrations of oxygenated and deoxygenated haemoglobin.

sampling_frequency_hz.description: Sampling rate of the recording in hertz.

short_channel_count.description: How many short-separation channels were used, which measure scalp signal for regression rather than brain signal.

source_detector_distances_mm.description: Separation between each source and detector in millimetres, as a list. It sets the depth the channel is sensitive to.

wavelengths_nm.description: The nominal emitted wavelengths in nanometres, as a list.

FactorLevel.description: One factor and the level of it that a cohort or condition represents.

factor_name.description: Name of the experimental or participant factor, verbatim. Must match the name of a categorical Term of this analysis.

level.description: The level of that factor which this cohort or condition carries, verbatim.

FactorLevel.title: FactorLevel

Group.description: An extracted participant group record. Source-derived attributes are ExtractedValues; local_id is a generated document-local identifier.

acquired_count.description: Participants scanned as text or number; mapper parses to integer.

age_maximum.description: Maximum reported age as text; mapper parses float.

age_mean.description: Mean age as text (e.g., "32.4" or "32.4 years"); mapper parses float and unit separately.

age_median.description: Median age as text; mapper parses float.

age_minimum.description: Minimum reported age as text; mapper parses float.

age_standard_deviation.description: Age SD as text; mapper parses float.

age_unit.description: Age unit as stated (e.g., "years", "months"); mapper normalizes to controlled vocabulary.

approached_count.description: Participants approached as text or number; mapper parses to integer.

clinical_characteristics.description: Disease duration, severity, and related clinical summaries, verbatim.

consented_count.description: Participants consented as text or number; mapper parses to integer.

description.description: Narrative definition of the group, verbatim.

diagnostic_instrument.description: Assessment instruments used, verbatim, one per entry.

diagnostic_system.description: Diagnostic system as stated (e.g., "DSM-5", "ICD-10"); mapper normalizes abbreviations.

enrolled_count.description: Participants enrolled as text or number; mapper parses to integer.

ethnicity_distribution.description: Ethnic distribution using the study's own category labels, one entry each.

excluded_count.description: Participants excluded as text or number; mapper parses to integer.

exclusion_criteria.description: Exclusion criteria, one per list entry, verbatim.

gender_distribution.description: Self-described gender distribution, kept separate from phenotypic sex. One entry per reported category.

handedness_distribution.description: Handedness distribution, one entry per reported category -- right, left, ambidextrous.

inclusion_criteria.description: Eligibility requirements, one per list entry, verbatim.

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor, unique within this extraction document (e.g., "hc", "pd_patients"). Used for cross-references in Analysis and Experiment records. The mapper resolves these to stable storage IDs.

medical_condition.description: Medical, neurological, psychiatric, developmental, or physiological condition(s), verbatim, one per entry.

medication_status.description: Medication exposure and state during acquisition or testing, verbatim.

name.description: Group label as stated in the paper.

race_distribution.description: Racial distribution using the study's own category labels, one entry each.

sex_distribution.description: Phenotypic sex distribution, one entry per category the source reports, each with its label and a count or percentage.

species.description: Species of this cohort, verbatim, such as human, rhesus macaque, or Sprague-Dawley rat; mapper normalizes. Populate it for human cohorts too -- everything else on this record reads as human by default, so leaving it out is not the same as saying human.

Group.title: Group

GroupTerm.description: One participant cohort in an analysis, the side of the comparison it sits on, and how many of its participants the analysis included.

factor_levels.description: The factorial cell this cohort represents, for a crossed design such as genotype by diagnosis. Leave empty for the ordinary case of one cohort per group.

n.description: Participants from this cohort included in this analysis, when reported per analysis.

role.description: Which side of the comparison this cohort sits on, verbatim as the source frames it -- the greater side, the lesser side, or simply included without a direction; mapper normalizes. Omit when the source compares the cohorts but does not report which way the effect went.

GroupTerm.title: GroupTerm

alpha_level.description: The error rate the test was held to -- the family-wise, false-discovery, or nominal alpha, usually 0.05. Distinct from a threshold value: alpha is the rate being controlled, a threshold is what implements it.

cluster_extent_threshold.description: The minimum surviving cluster size, in the unit the source uses -- contiguous voxels, vertices, or a volume. Record the number as given, without converting it.

cluster_forming_threshold_value.description: The threshold deciding which elements join a cluster, when the source reports it separately from voxelwise_threshold_value. In most software these are the same number and only one is populated; fill both only when the paper gives two distinct values.

clusterwise_threshold_value.description: The cluster-level threshold a whole cluster had to pass, as distinct from the height threshold its elements passed. 'p < 0.001 voxelwise, cluster-level p < 0.05' gives 0.001 above and 0.05 here.

correction_scope.description: The space the correction was applied over, verbatim -- the whole brain, a mask, an ROI set, one hemisphere. A correction over a small mask is a weaker claim than the same method over the whole brain, which is why the scope is recorded and not only the method.

inference_level.description: The element inference was drawn about, verbatim -- a voxel, a vertex, a cluster, a region, or a network; mapper normalizes. A voxelwise threshold followed by a cluster-extent criterion is cluster-level inference, not voxel-level.

multiple_comparison_method.description: How the multiple-comparison problem was handled, verbatim -- FWE, FDR, Bonferroni, permutation, Monte Carlo simulation, small-volume correction, or none. Record every one a paper applies, not just the first.

neighborhood_definition.description: The adjacency rule deciding whether two elements belong to one cluster, verbatim -- face, edge, or corner connectivity, often written as 6, 18, or 26 neighbours.

number_of_tests.description: How many tests the correction accounted for, when the source states it.

permutation_count.description: How many permutations, randomizations, or simulations the inference rested on.

search_volume.description: The size of the space searched, verbatim as reported -- a volume, a mask size, or a count of voxels or vertices.

tfce_parameters.description: TFCE height and extent exponents, verbatim, when the source reports them.

tfce_used.description: Whether threshold-free cluster enhancement was used, which replaces a height threshold with a weighting by cluster support.

voxelwise_threshold_type.description: What voxelwise_threshold_value is a value of, verbatim -- an uncorrected p, an FDR q, or a t, z, or F statistic.

voxelwise_threshold_value.description: The per-element height threshold applied before any correction or cluster formation, as a number: p < 0.001 uncorrected gives 0.001, Z > 3.09 gives 3.09. voxelwise_threshold_type says which of those the number is.

acquisition_voxel_size_mm.description: Acquired voxel dimensions in millimetres, as a list of the three edge lengths. The size at acquisition, not after resampling in preprocessing.

echo_time_seconds.description: Echo time in seconds, as a list when the sequence is multi-echo -- one value per echo, in the order the source gives them.

magnetic_field_strength_tesla.description: Scanner field strength in tesla, as reported.

mr_acquisition_type.description: Whether the sequence was acquired in 2D slices or as a 3D volume, verbatim. Distinguishes a slab-based EPI from a whole-volume acquisition.

number_of_volumes.description: How many volumes the functional run contains, sometimes reported as time points or dynamics.

pulse_sequence_type.description: Pulse sequence family, verbatim -- EPI, MPRAGE, SPGR, spin echo.

repetition_time_seconds.description: Repetition time in seconds. Convert a value the paper gives in milliseconds; the unit here is seconds.

Measure.description: The scientific quantity of the map, in the source's own words.

source_label.description: The paper's own term for the measure, verbatim, such as "BOLD signal change", "grey matter volume", or "fractional anisotropy". The mapper normalizes it to a family and a type.

specific_metric.description: Named metric when the measure is a specific one, verbatim, such as fractional anisotropy, ALFF, or a named tracer binding potential.

unit.description: Reported unit of the measure, verbatim, when meaningful.

Measure.title: Measure

ModelEstimation.description: Extracted record of how a model was specified and estimated.

hrf_model.description: Haemodynamic response basis the design matrix used, verbatim, such as "canonical HRF", "canonical plus temporal derivative", or "FIR". Omit for a measure that models no timeseries.

level.description: Analysis level as stated (e.g., "first-level", "group-level"); mapper normalizes to run/session/subject/group vocabulary.

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor.

model_type.description: Model family as stated (e.g., "GLM", "general linear model", "ICA"); mapper normalizes to controlled vocabulary.

software.description: Statistical software name and version, verbatim.

ModelEstimation.title: ModelEstimation

NotStructurableDetails.description: Payload for an effect that is grounded in the source but has no stable structured decomposition.

explanation.description: What specifically could not be represented.

reason.description: Why the effect could not be structured, verbatim or as judged -- a method-specific derived metric, too little standard structure, or a source too vague; mapper normalizes.

NotStructurableDetails.title: NotStructurableDetails

OtherAnalysisDetails.description: Method payload for a method outside the first-class families, such as a mediation analysis.

method_label.description: The source's name for the method, verbatim.

reason_first_class_type_not_used.description: Why none of the five named method payloads fits this analysis.

structured_details.description: JSON-encoded method-specific payload, when the method has structure worth keeping. A string because the schema has no free-form object range.

OtherAnalysisDetails.title: OtherAnalysisDetails

OtherModality.description: Extracted record of an acquisition whose modality none of MRI, EEG, FNIRS, or PET covers. Its parameters go in the enclosing Acquisition's description or structured_details, which no modality normalizes.

modality_label.description: The paper's own name for the modality or recording technique, verbatim.

reason_no_modality_class_used.description: Why the MRI, EEG, FNIRS, and PET fields do not describe this acquisition.

OtherModality.title: OtherModality

image_units.description: The unit the image voxels are in, verbatim -- Bq/mL, SUV, a binding potential.

mode_of_administration.description: How the tracer was given, verbatim -- a bolus, a constant infusion, or a bolus plus infusion.

reconstructed_voxel_size_mm.description: Voxel dimensions after reconstruction, in millimetres, as a list of the three edge lengths.

scan_type.description: Whether the analysed data are a static image or a dynamic time series, verbatim. It decides whether kinetic modelling was possible.

spatial_resolution_mm.description: The scanner's effective resolution, usually as a full width at half maximum in millimetres. Coarser than the voxel size, and the figure that limits localization.

tracer_name.description: The injected tracer compound as the paper names it, such as FDG or raclopride.

tracer_radionuclide.description: The isotope labelling the tracer, verbatim -- C11, F18, O15.

uptake_time_seconds.description: How long after administration the analysed data were acquired, in seconds.

PaperSection.description: Deterministic document index entry for every section and subsection in the processed paper text. Character offsets use the same normalized source text and half-open interval convention [start_char, end_char).

end_char.description: Exclusive character offset immediately before the next same-or-higher-level heading or EOF.

level.description: Heading depth; 0 is the document-level title, 1 is a top-level section.

ordinal.description: Zero-based document order of the section heading.

parent_section.description: title of the immediately containing section, when applicable.

start_char.description: Inclusive character offset of the section heading in normalized source text.

title.description: Section or subsection heading text after deterministic normalization.

PaperSection.title: PaperSection

PerformanceMetric.description: One reported performance measure of a decoding analysis, and its value.

name.description: The measure as the source names it, verbatim, such as accuracy, AUC, d-prime, sensitivity, or specificity.

reference_value.description: Numeric reference this measure was compared against, when reported -- chance for an accuracy, zero for a correlation. Each measure carries its own.

relation.description: Whether this measure was above or below its reference, verbatim; mapper normalizes.

value.description: The value as reported, verbatim in the source's own scale. Do not convert a percentage to a proportion or the reverse.

PerformanceMetric.title: PerformanceMetric

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor.

software.description: Software packages used, verbatim, one per entry.

steps.description: Ordered preprocessing steps, verbatim, in execution order.

SimilarityDetails.description: Method payload for a representational-similarity analysis.

competing_models.description: Other models the reported model was compared against, verbatim.

model.description: The model dissimilarity matrix tested, verbatim. Omit for a model-free test such as within- versus between-category pattern similarity.

neural_representation.description: How the neural pattern was defined, verbatim, such as the voxel set or time window used.

SimilarityDetails.title: SimilarityDetails

Statistic.description: The test statistic reported for an analysis and its degrees of freedom.

degrees_of_freedom_denominator.description: Denominator degrees of freedom, as reported. For a single-degree-of-freedom statistic this is the only one -- t(151) is F(1,151), so record 151 here and leave the numerator out.

degrees_of_freedom_numerator.description: Numerator degrees of freedom, as reported. Normally only an F or a likelihood ratio has one.

family.description: Test statistic as reported, verbatim -- t, z, F, chi-square, a likelihood ratio, a beta, or a correlation; mapper normalizes.

Statistic.title: Statistic

coordinate_space.description: The space the map is in, verbatim. May differ from the space the paper's tables report, which is why it is recorded per map.

description.description: Notes on where the map came from and how it relates to the reported analysis.

is_thresholded.description: Whether the shared image has already had a threshold applied, which decides whether it can be re-analysed.

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor.

map_type.description: What the image contains, verbatim -- a statistic map, an effect estimate, a variance map, or a thresholded label map.

statistic_type.description: The statistical quantity the map's values are, verbatim -- t, z, beta, a p value.

url.description: Where the map can be retrieved, or the landing page of the archive holding it.

Study.description: Root extraction record for a single publication.

acquisitions.description: Acquisition protocols extracted from the paper.

assessments.description: Assessment records extracted from the paper. Every assessment a Term or an Analysis refers to must appear here.

conditions.description: Experimental conditions extracted from the paper.

description.description: Brief summary of the study aims in the extractor's own words.

design.description: Verbatim or closely paraphrased study design description.

experiments.description: Tasks or paradigms extracted from the paper.

external_datasets.description: Named external datasets used, cited, or made available by the study.

groups.description: Participant groups extracted from the paper.

model_estimations.description: Model estimation records extracted from the paper.

preprocessings.description: Preprocessing pipelines extracted from the paper.

tables.description: Result tables extracted from the paper.

terms.description: Term records extracted from the paper. Analyses refer to them by local_id, so a term used by two analyses is one record here, not two.

Study.title: Study

description.description: Summary of the table's role in the study.

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor.

table_number.description: Printed table identifier, verbatim (e.g., "Table 2", "Supplementary Table S4").

Term.description: One term of a statistical model, categorical or continuous. Replaces the factor and predictor split: what matters is whether the term is categorical or continuous.

assessment.description: local_id of the Assessment supplying a continuous term's measurement.

association_direction.description: Reported sign of a continuous term's coefficient, verbatim; mapper normalizes. Omit when the source reports no direction.

conditions.description: local_ids of Condition records a categorical term ranges over.

functional_form.description: Shape of the term's relationship to the measure, verbatim -- linear, quadratic, a product, an absolute value, log-transformed, or a named transform; mapper normalizes. Do not report a non-linear or transformed term as linear.

groups.description: local_ids of Group records a categorical term ranges over.

interaction_with.description: local_ids of the other Term records this term is a product of, when the source names an interaction term.

levels.description: The factor's level labels, verbatim, when they are not all present as condition or group terms of the analysis.

local_id.description: Short label assigned by the extractor.

name.description: Term label as the source names it, verbatim. Also the factor's identity, referred to by FactorLevel.factor_name.

role.description: How the term enters the model, verbatim or as evident -- a term of interest, a covariate controlled for, a moderator, a mediator; mapper normalizes. Say "covariate" for something the paper controls for rather than tests.

source_definition.description: The source's own definition of the term, verbatim, including the origin of a continuous term that no Assessment supplies -- age, dose, a motion parameter, cardiac phase, scanner drift.

type.description: Whether the term is categorical or continuous, as stated or as evident from the model; mapper normalizes.

unit.description: Unit of a continuous term, verbatim, when meaningful.

variation_level.description: The level a continuous term varies at, verbatim -- within subject, between subjects, or both; mapper normalizes. This is what separates a parametric modulation from a cross-subject regression.

Term.title: Term

ValueSource.description: Describes how an extracted value relates to the source material.
ValueSource.title: ValueSource

description: Root extraction record for a single publication.

acquisitions.description: Acquisition protocols extracted from the paper.

assessments.description: Assessment records extracted from the paper. Every assessment a Term or an Analysis refers to must appear here.

conditions.description: Experimental conditions extracted from the paper.

description.description: Brief summary of the study aims in the extractor's own words.

design.description: Verbatim or closely paraphrased study design description.

experiments.description: Tasks or paradigms extracted from the paper.

external_datasets.description: Named external datasets used, cited, or made available by the study.

groups.description: Participant groups extracted from the paper.

model_estimations.description: Model estimation records extracted from the paper.

tables.description: Result tables extracted from the paper.

terms.description: Term records extracted from the paper. Analyses refer to them by local_id, so a term used by two analyses is one record here, not two.
